plan.name: Prioritize Cleaning Area First
plan.strategy: Focus on the sinkbasin first, assuming the spatula may be there for cleaning, then check other areas.
steps: Check the drawer first to see if a clean spatula is already there.
If not found, move to the sinkbasin and look for a spatula, as it may be there for cleaning.
If a spatula is found in the sinkbasin, clean it if necessary.
After cleaning, place the spatula in the drawer.
If not found in the sinkbasin, search countertops and cabinets next.
